about: The curated list of Baja Analytics templates. Edit this file to add, retitle, describe or retire a template, then run `node tools/analytics-templates/build-index.js` to regenerate index.json. Template payloads stay where they are under baja/templates/; `file` points at them. `also` lists byte-identical copies of the same payload elsewhere in that tree.

categories.title: Lab analysis
categories.description: Plate and assay calculations: qPCR, standard curves, normalization.

categories.title: Drug development
categories.description: Nonclinical, IND and CMC planning and budgets for oligonucleotide programs.

categories.title: Screening operations
categories.description: Cost, capital and throughput models for oligo screening labs.

categories.title: Lab and company models
categories.description: Staffing, capital, P&L and cap-table models for labs and startups.

categories.title: General examples
categories.description: Worked examples outside life sciences that show what the workbook can do.

templates.title: qPCR ΔΔCt, duplicate wells
templates.description: Relative expression from a 384-well qPCR run with target and housekeeping genes in duplicate. Averages replicates, then computes ΔCt, ΔΔCt against the control wells, relative expression and percent of control, with a per-well report.
templates.notes: Contains an unrelated embedded model (startup_captable) that roughly doubles its size.

templates.title: qPCR ΔΔCt, single wells
templates.description: Relative expression from a 384-well qPCR run with one target and one housekeeping Ct per well. Computes ΔCt, ΔΔCt against the control wells, relative expression and percent of control.
templates.notes: Also carries the duplicate-replicate ct_values table and an unrelated embedded startup_captable model.

templates.title: Relative expression, normalized to total RNA
templates.description: Normalizes target Cq to housekeeping Cq and to RiboGreen total RNA, using qPCR and RiboGreen standard-curve slopes and intercepts, and reports expression as percent of untreated control (UTC mean).

templates.title: Total-RNA normalized percent control (data table)
templates.description: A single 176-row plate table with well position, sample, target and housekeeping Cq, RiboGreen signal and the RiboGreen-adjusted, target-normalized value. The data layer behind the relative-expression model.

templates.title: Fluorescence standard curve
templates.description: Well ID, sample, concentration, RFU and background-subtracted RFU for a dilution series, laid out for fitting a standard curve.

templates.title: IND submission steps, n-of-1
templates.description: Ten steps to an individualized (n-of-1) IND, each with details and an estimated time to execute.

templates.title: Nonclinical testing of an ASO
templates.description: Twenty nonclinical activities for an antisense oligonucleotide, each with an estimated duration.

templates.title: In vivo toxicology timeline and budget
templates.description: Study components with duration in days and cost in USD, plus running cumulative days and cumulative cost.

templates.title: In vivo tox CRO budget and timeline
templates.description: CRO line items (units, unit cost, quantity), consultant hours by phase, a phase timeline in weeks and summary totals, with the procedure steps and nonclinical activity checklists alongside.
templates.notes: Bundles a DEL screening campaign; overlaps heavily with del-screen.ljl.

templates.title: GMP ASO synthesis calculator
templates.description: Clinical-batch cost for a GMP antisense oligonucleotide: chemicals and quantities (backbone, bases, modifications, purification), analytical and stability QC, formulation and CMC documentation, rolled into a clinical synthesis budget.

templates.title: NSF SBIR budget justification
templates.description: An NSF SBIR budget built section by section: senior and other personnel, salaries and fringe, travel, supplies, consultants, subawards, other direct costs, indirect costs and fee, with totals and consistency checks.

templates.title: Drug discovery and development cost
templates.description: Nineteen cost categories from discovery through development, summed by formula.

templates.title: Drug repurposing screen
templates.description: A repurposing screen of FDA-approved compounds: an objective note, the 384-well protocol steps with timings, and the equipment capital (liquid handler and readers) with price ranges.

templates.title: Drug repurposing with CRO tox budget
templates.description: The drug repurposing screen combined with a CRO in vivo tox budget (parameters, CRO items, consultant hours, timeline and totals).

templates.title: DNA-encoded library screen
templates.description: Cost and operations for a DEL screening campaign: screening line items, procedure steps by month, and a cost summary.
templates.notes: Also embeds the in vivo tox CRO budget.

templates.title: RNA therapeutics program budget
templates.description: A three-year RNA therapeutics pipeline: studies by year (in vitro lead, in vivo lead, NHP), study expense, pipeline cost and FTE salaries.
templates.notes: Contains an unrelated real-estate license checklist and a software steps table.

templates.title: RNA screening cost per screen
templates.description: Cost of goods for a primary ASO screen (consumables and reagents for 80 ASOs in duplicate or triplicate), plus equipment capital by priority, FTEs and an RNA pipeline budget.
templates.notes: 12 MB: carries several embedded models (planning, startup, pipeline manager). Worth splitting.

templates.title: RNA screening capital, three years
templates.description: Cost of goods for a primary screen, screening labor, FTEs and a 40-item equipment list rolled into three-year capital.

templates.title: Three-year RNA screening output and P&L
templates.description: Synthesis, screening and software operations over three years: FTEs, synthesis expenses and plates per year, screen costs and output, asset value by stage, software P&L and an overall screening P&L.
templates.notes: 3.9 MB; embeds the synthesis, assets and software sub-models whole.

templates.title: ASO screening budget
templates.description: FTEs, screen costs (primary, dose response, tox), screening capital, and hourly labor for primary and dose-response screens.

templates.title: Screening labor
templates.description: Labor rate and hours for primary and dose-response screens, with FTEs, screen costs and screening capital.
templates.notes: Its package is named hellowlrld; near-duplicate of the ASO screening budget.

templates.title: Antisense oligosynthesis lab
templates.description: A full oligo synthesis and screening business: synthesis FTEs, reagents and plates per year, equipment and synthesis capital, pipeline studies and asset value, software licenses and P&L, screening output and the flywheel.
templates.notes: 16 MB, the largest template. Embeds several sub-models.

templates.title: Antisense chemistry lab, simplified
templates.description: A smaller version of the oligosynthesis lab model: synthesis FTEs and expenses, capital, pipeline cost, software P&L and screening output.

templates.title: Synthetic chemistry lab
templates.description: Synthesis and screening operations with FTEs, capital, pipeline and asset value, software P&L and screening costs.
templates.notes: Largely the same tables as the antisense chemistry lab models.

templates.title: Lab startup capital
templates.description: Instruments by category with cost and count, rolled into total startup capital, alongside a shared-lab consortium pricing model.

templates.title: Shared lab consortium
templates.description: A membership-funded shared lab: parameters, member and non-member pricing, operating costs and revenue, FTEs and sustainability metrics.

templates.title: Rare disease synthesis consortium
templates.description: A nonprofit synthesis consortium for rare disease: inputs, membership model, revenue from members, COGS, gross profit, operating expenses and operating profit.

templates.title: RNA pipeline manager
templates.description: Studies by year, study expense, pipeline cost and FTE salaries for a small RNA pipeline.

templates.title: Startup cap table, SAFE to priced round
templates.description: Converts SAFEs (amount, cap, discount) into a priced round and shows share price, pro rata, post-round ownership and implied valuation for investors and founders.

templates.title: Simple monthly and annual budget
templates.description: Budget categories with monthly and annual amounts and their totals.

templates.title: FTE plan, three years
templates.description: Positions and salaries with headcount by year and a total, the staffing block most of the company models reuse.

templates.title: Itemized cost
templates.description: Item and cost rows for a quick itemized estimate.

templates.title: Item cost (blank)
templates.description: An empty item and cost table.

templates.title: Summary amount
templates.description: A single-cell total, for showing one rolled-up figure on the canvas.

templates.title: Cost summary
templates.description: A single-cell cost summary driven by a formula.

templates.title: Software company P&L
templates.description: A three-year (2025 to 2027) software company P&L with 24 line items and 21 formulas.

templates.title: Software products P&L
templates.description: A 40-row P&L for software products with 15 formulas.

templates.title: Nonclinical development of individualized ASOs
templates.description: Seventeen milestones over about seven months: therapeutic goal, chemistry class, in vitro and in vivo proof of concept, off-target analysis, hybridization-independent toxicity, a single general tox study with FDA input, and hERG considerations.

templates.title: ASO nonclinical plan (copy)
templates.description: The same milestones as the individualized ASO nonclinical timeline. The file is named phase 1 clinical timeline but holds the nonclinical plan.

templates.title: Phase 1 clinical trial
templates.description: Ten phases over a year: pre-IND preparation, IND submission and FDA review, site selection and IRB, start-up, recruitment, SAD and MAD dosing, safety and PK analysis, data cleaning and statistics, and the clinical study report.
templates.notes: Internal timeline name is 'test', which shows as its title on the canvas.

templates.title: Substantial evidence path (FDA guidance)
templates.description: Planning and pre-IND, preclinical and mechanistic studies, one adequate and well-controlled trial with confirmatory evidence, end-of-phase 2 or pre-NDA meeting, NDA or BLA submission and FDA review, 2025 to 2030.

templates.title: Rare disease ASO program
templates.description: Lead ID, tolerability lead ID, rodent tox, HPLC method development, manufacturing setup and release, GLP tox and IND for a rare disease ASO program.

templates.title: Blank timeline
templates.description: An empty timeline with a start and an end date, ready for your own milestones.

templates.title: One-day timeline
templates.description: An empty single-day timeline for scheduling a run or an experiment day.

templates.title: Mars mission, 30 years
templates.description: A 2025 to 2055 program from mission design through uncrewed missions, crew training, transit, landing and early surface stays.

templates.title: Mars transit
templates.description: Pre-launch checkout through trans-Mars injection, transit, orbit insertion, landing and surface setup.

templates.title: Real estate investment projection
templates.description: A pro forma cash-flow model that forecasts multifamily investment performance from acquisition to sale.
templates.notes: 8 MB: embeds the construction budget and the startup cap table.

templates.title: Three-story commercial building
templates.description: Construction budget by floor: labor, materials, equipment rental and durations, permits, contingency, land and design fees, rolled into total project cost.

templates.title: Getting a real estate license
templates.description: Steps to a state real estate license with time for each.

templates.title: Brewery with taproom
templates.description: Volumes, revenue and revenue deductions for a brewery with a taproom.
templates.notes: Embeds the construction budget and the startup cap table.

templates.title: Hot dog truck
templates.description: Products with unit price and units sold, summed into total sales. The smallest working model; good for learning the workbook.

templates.title: Professional poker
templates.description: Cash-game and tournament inputs and derived results, combined into totals and the probability of a profitable year.

templates.title: Author business
templates.description: Novels per series, writing days per novel and books released, projected into book revenue.
templates.notes: Also contains the RNA pipeline manager and real-estate license models.

templates.title: Cost of owning a general aviation airplane
templates.description: Purchase price, annual insurance and hangar, fuel and maintenance per hour, flight hours and training, rolled into the annual cost of ownership.

templates.title: IPA homebrew
templates.description: Brew-day steps with the time each takes.
templates.notes: Also contains the screening labor model.

templates.title: Las Vegas house edge
templates.description: Common casino games with typical bets and house edge.

templates.title: Short selling and options calculator
templates.description: Sixteen metrics for a short position, with seven formulas.

templates.title: Auto manufacturing: engine assumptions
templates.description: Engine production assumptions for the auto manufacturing example.

templates.title: Auto manufacturing: tariffs
templates.description: A 24-row tariff and cost table with 12 formulas for the auto manufacturing example.
